<div id='about'  class='avia-section av-682sq-6edecb3bcf77bbfc5d5b5f424ced24ae main_color avia-section-default avia-no-shadow  avia-builder-el-1  el_after_av_fullscreen  el_before_av_section  avia-bg-style-scroll container_wrap fullsize'  data-section-bg-repeat='no-repeat'><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><div class='template-page content  av-content-full alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-570'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'>
<div  class='av-special-heading av-2xef6-2844d2a080090886945c2e2f027f5901 av-special-heading-h2 blockquote modern-quote modern-centered  avia-builder-el-2  el_before_av_one_third  avia-builder-el-first  av-inherit-size'><h2 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >KITESURFING AT KITERIDERS</h2><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<div  class='flex_column av-gx6cq2-d8ce3f4bfe4c4823dd474ace78f7de03 av_one_third  avia-builder-el-3  el_after_av_heading  el_before_av_one_third  first flex_column_div  '     ><div  class='av-special-heading av-lvxeq-38f3089fa4d232d14666c9216e80e542 av-special-heading-h2 blockquote modern-quote  avia-builder-el-4  el_before_av_textblock  avia-builder-el-first  av-thin-font'><h2 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  ><strong>KITERIDERS</strong> MONTENEGRO</h2><div class='av-subheading av-subheading_below'><p><strong>LEARN</strong> TO KITESURF<strong> IN EUROPE</strong></p>
</div><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-gol9eq-016238da45ebcef9d789a1a99ee81c52 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p>Our team has already had more than 10 years of teaching experience in kitesurfing at our <a href="www.kiteriders.at" target="_blank" rel="noopener">home spot </a>at Lake Neusiedl in Podersdorf/Austria. After hearing about this unique top spot for kitesurfing in Montenegro and after assessing its quality ourselves, we decided to start running a kitecenter on one of the most windy and beautiful sandy beaches here together with some locals. We want to share our passion for kitesurfing with you and our long-time experience, a trained and motivated team, modern teaching techniques and the most modern equipment are a guarantee for your ideal learning progress in our tailor-made kitesurfing courses. No matter whether  your goal is freestyle, free-ride, foiling or big-air &#8211; as soon as your passion for kitesurfing is sparked off,  it is only up to you to decide how far to go. Hang loose!!!</p>
<h5>3 REASONS WHY PRECISELY OUR SCHOOL:</h5>
<ul>
<li>modern teaching techniques and a motivated team with more than 15 years of experience</li>
<li>private lessons for the best possible progress and the most up-to-date kitesurfing equipment provided by Duotone Kiteboarding</li>
<li>daily course start and only VDWS kiteschool at the spot</li>
</ul>
</div></section>
<div  class='avia-image-container av-geqzju-802be9c78e32c8a6ec7ef202f4524835 av-styling- av-img-linked avia-align-center  avia-builder-el-6  el_after_av_textblock  avia-builder-el-last '   itemprop="image" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/ImageObject" ><div class="avia-image-container-inner"><div class="avia-image-overlay-wrap"><a href="https://www.vdws.de/" class='avia_image '  target="_blank"  rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label='vdws_hp_01'><img decoding="async" fetchpriority="high" class='wp-image-1336 avia-img-lazy-loading-not-1336 avia_image ' src="https://www.kitesurfing-montenegro.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/vdws_hp_01-300x150.png" alt='' title='vdws_hp_01'  height="150" width="300"  itemprop="thumbnailUrl" srcset="https://www.kitesurfing-montenegro.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/vdws_hp_01-300x150.png 300w, https://www.kitesurfing-montenegro.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/vdws_hp_01.png 357w" sizes="(max-width: 300px) 100vw, 300px" /></a></div></div></div></div><div  class='flex_column av-gbc1mi-5cff846cb723453e7174c0cf2afb5c6f av_one_third  avia-builder-el-7  el_after_av_one_third  el_before_av_one_third  flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding  '     ><div  class='av-special-heading av-hk98q-fecc99b3c3f377e8d7cca675970abc3b av-special-heading-h2 blockquote modern-quote  avia-builder-el-8  el_before_av_textblock  avia-builder-el-first  av-thin-font av-linked-heading'><h2 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  ><strong>KITE HOLIDAY</strong> SUMMER 2026<strong> IN ULCINJ</strong></h2><div class='av-subheading av-subheading_below'><p>THE NEW <strong>KITE TOP SPOT</strong> IN EUROPE</p>
</div><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-mle62oxx-50086395db586124183fa9e932d928b3 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p>Our kitesurfing centre is located directly on a sandy beach called Velika Plaza (Long Beach), which spread over 14 km. Reliable thermal wind systems guarantee optimal kitesurfing conditions from May till September. Especially beginners and newcomers find perfect conditions for fast learning progress by being provided with a wide standing area of a sandy quality (without dangerous riffs or rocks), shallow water and constant side-onshore-winds. Apart from this, we have a big teaching zone at our disposal, which is reserved only for us and our guests.</p>
<p>Combined with our <strong>stylish <a href="https://www.kitesurfing-montenegro.com/#packages" target="_blank" rel="noopener">accommodation</a></strong>, which is perfectly tailored to kiters and located close to the spot, we offer you the perfect holiday.</p>
<p>No matter how you imagine your holiday, when it comes to kitesurfing, you&#8217;ve definitely come to the right place!!!</p>
<h5><strong>3 REASONS WHY THIS KITESPOT</strong></h5>
<ul>
<li>perfect conditions for beginners with a huge, 14 km long, fine-grained sandy beach</li>
<li>excellent thermals with up to 80% wind probability</li>
<li>stylish accommodation in the Kiteriders Garden Villas</li>
</ul>
</div></section></div><div  class='flex_column av-fqelea-d613ad1ec8ec250d941afc1478e39c02 av_one_third  avia-builder-el-10  el_after_av_one_third  el_before_av_video  flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding  '     ><div  class='av-special-heading av-8fw96-2d4362d74826da47c06af96ef2870510 av-special-heading-h2 blockquote modern-quote  avia-builder-el-11  el_before_av_textblock  avia-builder-el-first  av-thin-font'><h2 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >WELCOME TO <strong>MONTENEGRO</strong></h2><div class='av-subheading av-subheading_below'><p><strong>KITESURFING &#038; WINGFOILING</strong> IN <strong>ULCINJ</strong></p>
</div><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-fgincq-f835d6111aefeefd6fe80c390b4c0411 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p>Montenegro has an area which can be compared to one and a half times the area of Greater London and is thus one of the smallest countries in Europe. Considering its size, the variety this small country offers is even more impressive. It combines kilometres of beaches, hidden bays, lively ports, picturesque mountain villages and a wild beauty in the interior mountain regions which is waiting for being discovered. Also for those who want to explore the lively nightlife in numerous discotheques, Ulcinj is the right place. So it is not surprising that Montenegro has been chosen regularly as one of the top tourist destinations of the world as recently by the New York Times, where it was rated as one of “The Top 31 Places-to-go Worldwide” and it ranked second in “Best in Travel 2013” in the Lonely Planet assessment.</p>
<h5> 3 REASONS FOR YOUR HOLIDAYS IN MONTENEGRO:</h5>
<ul>
<li>breath-taking scenery and endless sandy beaches</li>
<li>many options for alternative activities (rafting, mountain biking, diving, partying, swimming and relaxing on the beaches… )</li>
<li>direct flights from many European destinations</li>
</ul>
</div></section></div><div  class='avia-video av-f9w0ay-dee588b2b0fec2167c48a99f722c9a74 avia-video-16-9 av-no-preview-image avia-video-load-always av-lazyload-immediate av-lazyload-video-embed'  itemprop="video" itemtype="https://schema.org/VideoObject"  data-original_url='https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=77ahCZ3TP4Y'><div class='av-click-to-play-overlay'><div class="avia_playpause_icon"></div></div></div>

We also offer storage capacities at our kitecenter where you can store your equipment directly and safely at our station. This option includes using the complete infrastructure of the kitecenter, including showers, toilets, starting- and landing services and the shuttle service.<br />
</div></div></div></li>
<li><div class='av-catalogue-item av-mnpocvxw-c2fefe83085a72baebfe6d1e2e2962a4' ><div class="av-catalogue-item-inner"><div class="av-catalogue-title-container"><div class='av-catalogue-title'>Weekly Rent</div><div class='av-catalogue-price'>from € 339/week</div></div><div class="av-catalogue-content">
With this offer you will get a full week of rental at favorable conditions. With this offer you can choose from the whole range of our rental equipment including <strong>kites</strong>, <strong>boards</strong> and <strong>accessories</strong>.<br />
</div></div></div></li>

<div  class='av-special-heading av-pdmve-1be866a95f517b0d577e07de413d2bd1 av-special-heading-h2 custom-color-heading blockquote modern-quote modern-centered  avia-builder-el-56  avia-builder-el-no-sibling  av-thin-font av-inherit-size'><h2 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >YOUR KITE <strong>CAMP: PACKAGES</strong> WITH <strong>ACCOMMODATION</strong></h2><div class='av_custom_color av-subheading av-subheading_below'><p>KITESURFING HOLIDAYS FOR SINGLES, FRIENDS AND FAMILIES</p>
</div><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
</div></div></div></div></div><div id='after_section_8'  class='main_color av_default_container_wrap container_wrap fullsize'  ><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><div class='template-page content  av-content-full alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-570'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'></p>
<div  class='flex_column av-b6t7m-c24b4144b4c1bf199ea64dc8f2762924 av_one_full  avia-builder-el-57  el_after_av_section  el_before_av_one_half  avia-builder-el-first  first flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding  '     ><section  class='av_textblock_section av-6o6oj6-e209b53b991ea9404fde5b3f7007fdb4 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><h5>KITERIDERES GARDEN VILLAS</h5>
<p>Our Kiteriders Garden Villas, completed just right at the end of 2020, are waiting for you with <strong>cosy apartments, modern ambience, natural elegance and the welcoming Kiteriders atmosphere</strong>.</p>
<p>Being on holiday with us means experiencing moments of togetherness, making new friends and enjoying an all-round carefree kitesurfing holiday at one of the most beautiful kite spots in Europe. To meet all your expectations, we provide <strong>common areas</strong> as well as <strong>sufficient places of retreat</strong>, if you wish for privacy, in our Kiteriders Garden Villas compound.<strong> It is the perfect place for single travellers, couples, families or groups alike</strong>.</p>
<p>1 000 sqm of garden area including a barbecue area and a common area, a rooftop terrace of 80 sqm, and of course apartments offering you a high standard of comfort should provide the overall <strong>ambience for a never-to-be-forgotten kiting holiday</strong> in Montenegro!</p>
<p>We also gladly offer you individual <strong>packages with kitesurf training or rental in combination with our accommodation</strong> facilities in our exclusive<strong> “Kiteriders Garden Villas for Kiters and Friends Only”</strong>.</p>
</div></section></div>
<div  class='flex_column av-6vkiqy-f532b00a1a50c95d7e11b5abaffb7e86 av_one_half  avia-builder-el-59  el_after_av_one_full  el_before_av_one_half  first flex_column_div  column-top-margin'     ><section  class='av_textblock_section av-6o6oj6-1-6d57e81497b8c9b43d35cb234fc19ba2 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><h5>KITERIDERES GARDEN VILLAS &#8211; WIND | WATER | LIFESTYLE</h5>
<ul>
<li>only a few<strong> minutes to the beach </strong>by car</li>
<li><strong>Poolarea</strong> with sunbeds, chilloutzone and umbrellas</li>
<li><strong>shuttle service </strong>to the kitecenter included</li>
<li>shopping facilities and <strong>restaurants nearby</strong></li>
<li><strong>city centre of Ulcinj </strong>with lots of bars, restaurants, clubs and shops within 10 minutes by car</li>
<li>free <strong>WIFI, air-condition </strong>and <strong>free parking</strong></li>
<li>every <strong>apartment</strong> is equipped with a full-sized bed for two, an extendible couch, two separate rooms, cooking facilities, bathroom and toilet, bed linen and towels as well as a private balcony</li>
<li><strong>chillout zone, rooft top terrace, huge garden</strong> and <strong>barbecue</strong> area</li>
</ul>
<h5>ROOM RATES 2026:</h5>
<p><strong>Low Season*:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2-persons apartment <strong>only 50 Euro p.P./night</strong></li>
<li>Single use<strong> only 61 Euro p.P./night</strong></li>
<li>3-persons apartment <strong>only 39 Euro p.P./night</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>High Season*:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2-persons apartment <strong>only 56 Euro p.P./night</strong></li>
<li>Single use<strong> only 79 Euro p.P./night</strong></li>
<li>3-persons apartment <strong>only 43 Euro p.P./night</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><em>*Low Season: May 16th to July 5th</em></p>
<p><em>*High Season: July 6th to September 6th</em></p>
<p>Prices include all taxes and charges. Additional fee of 1 Euro per person/night for local tax.</p>

<div  class='av-special-heading av-38wtey-0155b368a541ba736cf1a25717dfc0c6 av-special-heading-h2 custom-color-heading blockquote modern-quote modern-centered  avia-builder-el-68  avia-builder-el-no-sibling  av-thin-font av-inherit-size'><h2 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  ><strong>Frequently</strong> asked <strong>Questions</strong></h2><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
</div></div></div></div></div><div id='av_section_10'  class='avia-section av-30zuxe-41a9fecac322d434bd77beba0b10b651 main_color avia-section-default avia-no-shadow  avia-builder-el-69  el_after_av_section  el_before_av_section  avia-bg-style-scroll container_wrap fullsize'  ><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><div class='template-page content  av-content-full alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-570'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'>
<div  class='flex_column av-2vnuw2-cb995f29410222797561a91259d7a6cf av_one_half  avia-builder-el-70  el_before_av_one_half  avia-builder-el-first  first flex_column_div  '     ><section  class='av_textblock_section av-2oc3iq-b46cfa63a062fdb0b0e8449f09466ae6 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><h3>When can I expect the best wind conditions for kitesurfing in Montenegro?</h3>
<p>In general, winds are quite reliable from mid-May until mid-September. You will find the most windy conditions with 80% windy days from  June to August. Normally the wind starts at about 1 pm and lasts until dawn. Mostly winds come from the northwest in a side-onshore direction.</p>
<h3>Which kite-size would you recommend?</h3>
<p>Winds normally range between 15 and 25 knots. For an average kitesurfer (about 70 kg) we recommend kites between 9 to 12 square meters. Our rental equipment offers a wide range of recent kites and boards from Duotone Kiteboarding which fit all conditions and all levels.</p>
<h3>Do I need a wetsuit for kitesurfing in Montenegro?</h3>
<p>The water temperature during the summer is about 26 degree Celsius and the air temperature is more than 30 degree Celsius. Boardshorts and Lycra are sufficient for kitesurfing during this period. In the spring and autumn months we recommend  a 3/2 steamer, an overknee or a medium insulated longsleeve wetsuit (depending on your temperature sensitivity). In our kitesurfing courses we provide you with high-quality wetsuits from ION without extra costs.</p>
<h3>Which requirements do I have to fulfil for the rental of kitesurfing equipment?</h3>
<p>To guarantee that you do not pose a risk to yourself or others, you should be able to go upwind as a requirement for rental at our center (equals VDWS level 5 or IKO level 3). In case of doubt or without a valid kitesurfing licence we may have to check your kite-surfing level directly within the context of the obligatory spot introductory briefing, which is included in every rental for free.</p>
<h3>What are the conditions at the spot like?</h3>
<p>As Montenegro is not so well known yet for kitesurfing as many other spots in Europe and as Ulcinj has a big kite zone of around 2 km, it is not too crowded. Advanced kitesurfers will find enough space on the water. As a beginner you will find perfect conditions as our kitecenter is able to provide a 250m-teaching zone with standing area, where we exclusively instruct our guests and thus there is sufficient place to practise kitesurfing safely and without stress.</p>
<h3>Do I have to consider something special for my journey to Montenegro?</h3>
<p>No. There is no need for special arrangements which are not needed for any other destination in Europe too. For entry you only need a valid passport (no visa necessary for EU-citizens). Security standards are comparable to Central Europe and there is a good health care system as well as good hygienic standards. The official currency is the Euro, which you can withdraw at the local cash machines.</p>
<h3>Why should kitesurfing be learned in a kitesurfing school?</h3>
<p>Kites can develop a lot of power and thus kitesurfing can be dangerous if you try to learn it on your own. By taking a course in a kitesurfing school, you quickly learn how to handle the kite safely and in order to minimize the risk of injuries, we practise how to act and react in critical situations. Furthermore, you gain solid knowledge of kitesurfing and you learn the basics for safely dealing with your kite and board step by step.</p>
<h3>Which equipment is included in the course offers?</h3>
<p>In our kitesurfing courses the complete equipment needed is provided, including kite, board, harness and wetsuit. Additionally, you also get your own course handbook for free.</p>
</div></section></div><div  class='flex_column av-2m6juq-81075a962bb6ee2b9c5df0605420cb91 av_one_half  avia-builder-el-72  el_after_av_one_half  avia-builder-el-last  flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding  '     ><section  class='av_textblock_section av-2ecqsi-513c3e85e656ad2c490212a3c83d699f '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><h3>Where can kitesurfing be learned most effectively?</h3>
<p>It is easy and safe to learn how to kitesurf in shallow water with a standing area. The beach of Ulcinj in Montenegro is thus perfect for beginners to get familiar with this fascinating sport. With a wide standing area and mainly side-onshore winds, kitesurfing can be learned most easily, effectively and safely in Montenegro. Through a combination of well-trained instructors, beginner-friendly and modern equipment and an optimal teaching environment, you can make your first (and of course a bit more advanced) steps in kitesurfing with a minimum of risk and a maximum of joy.</p>
<h3>What is the best way to get to Montenegro?</h3>
<p>The easiest way to get to Montenegro is by plane. There are several direct flights to the airports of Podgorica or Tivat, which are both about 90km away from our Kitecenter. From these two airports there is a shuttleservice available. Alternatively you can also travel to Dubrovnik airport in Croatia which is about 140km away. Depending on where you come from traveling by car might also be an option. There is free parking at the Kitehouse available.</p>
<h3>Is there a shuttle service?</h3>
<p>Yes, we offer a shuttle service from the airports of Podgorica or Tivat (please book in advance). We also offer a daily shuttle service between our kitecenter on the beach and our kitehouse for free. Alternatively, at the airport there are <a href="https://www.c24n.de/heqPUxk" target="_blank" rel="noopener">several rental car providers</a>.</p>
<h3>Are there any safety precautions?</h3>
<p>Yes, there are always a rescue boat as well as certified life guards on our beach. Furthermore, the members of our beach service make sure that the safety rules are respected on our beach sector and they act as helping hands for starting and landing the kites. For sure, having fun is a basis of our course concept, but we most certainly also teach you the basic security rules and train you for emergency situations in a safe environment to assure that you will have fun with kitesurfing for a long time.</p>
<h3>What are the prices in Montenegro?</h3>
<p>Even in tourist areas and on the beach the price level in Montenegro is much lower than in Central Europe. In particular, we do recommend the excellent fish restaurants which serve fresh fish at a good price every day.</p>
<h3>What else can I do in Montenegro apart from kitesurfing?</h3>
<p>Montenegro offers a lot of alternative activities such as rafting tours, mountain biking or diving. For relaxing you will find a 14 km sandy beach, which is divided into a swimming and a surfing zone. You can enjoy the evenings in a relaxing way at our beach bar or at a barbecue at our kitehouse. However, for those of you who want to experience the lively nightlife, there are lots of bars and discotheques in Ulcinj town as well.</p>
<h3>When does the season start and when does it end?</h3>
<p>Our kitesurfcenter is open daily from May to September.</p>
